clips.title: The story
paras: A crate bound for Tannok Frosthammer waits at the mouth of Coldridge Pass. Hands Springsprocket asks travelers to carry the inn supplies from Coldridge Valley to the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, since troggs have cut off the usual trade routes.

Troggs have overrun Coldridge Pass, straining Coldridge Valley’s ties to the rest of Dun Morogh. The valley has long sheltered young Ironforge dwarves and Gnomeregan survivors in exile. Now the mountain pass is perilous to cross. Mountaineers are spread thin guarding settlements and defensive perimeters, so scheduled supply escorts can be delayed for days.

At the mouth of Coldridge Pass, the gnome tinkerer Hands Springsprocket waits with a crate of supplies for the inn in Kharanos. He cannot safely carry it there himself. Travelers preparing to cross the pass can take the cargo to Tannok Frosthammer, the assistant at the Thunderbrew inn.

Kharanos marks your arrival in the wider lands of Dun Morogh. Tannok Frosthammer receives the supplies and says word from Anvilmar has been scarce since troggs disrupted travel through the pass. The delivery restores a fragile link of communication and trade between the two isolated dwarf communities.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?
You were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.
Anyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hi there! Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, at last, the supplies from Hands! I was beginning to worry, we've had scarce word from Anvilmar ever since the troggs overran the pass.
Thanks for bringing this to me, friend. And please, make yourself comfortable. You must be tired after your journey.
